next.reason: §2023:14.9.35.4 GR10 keeps identifier-1 available after REWRITE, adding 'provided that identifier-1 is not one or part of one of the record descriptions subordinate to the file-description'. 1985 already bars that case: §1985:VIII.4.6.3 SR1 'Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not refer to the same storage area', and all records of one FD share the record area, which 1985 GR4 makes unavailable after REWRITE. For every program 1985 accepts the result is the same.
